items.q: Dick Whittington. That was just – to have a place like that in your house to play in, wow.

ctx.x: Dick Whittington. That was just – to have a place like that in your house to play in, wow. It looked like a cathedral, with real high ceilings. It was incredible.
Then back to the trio format, 1991 – boy, 1990 and 1991. You’re just cranking them out. The only one, Ray Drummond and Ben Riley, Reservoir Records. I never heard of that company, Reservoir.
